validation: Explicit current Raiders/BOTW/ACNH authorization and exact title-selection hashes.
Each current selected independent source has genuine downloaded/decoded nativeFHD evidence and matching live mediaSHA.
ID prefix cannot rename a different game; actuallyInspected/purpose/reviewEvidence required.
Frame must fall inside selected inspected recommendedRanges.
On prepare only, FFprobe verifies actual source dimensions/duration and square-pixel compatibility.
Accurate input seek extracts one frame; contain scale+black letterbox+setsar preserves aspect, no crop/stretch, final1920x1080 PNG checked.
assetHelper.cache: production/local/reference-preserving-v3/assets-current only. Old local/assets candidate cache is never read or changed. Identical extraction parameters/sourceSHA/imageSHA reuse PNG bytes; changed selection/rights metadata can be rebound after validation without re-extraction. Changed pixel inputs stop rather than silently overwrite current cache.
assetHelper.copies: Copy only exact eight current PNG names into output/player-customization/preproduction-assets-v3, verifying bytes. Unrelated/old candidate filenames are not deleted.
assetHelper.receipts: Per-image ignored extraction JSON plus current production/reference-preserving-v3/visual-assets.json with source URL/recorder/fileSHA/time/purpose/evidence.
assetHelper.dryRun: Reads and hashes input specs/media but does not FFprobe, extract, mkdir, copy or write.
assetHelper.help: Stdlib only and no input reads.

annotationHelper.schema: Existing marks[] sourceKey/sourceSha256/type/localStart/localEnd/keyframes/label/labelAnchorSource/colorSemantics/nativeLineWidth/semanticPurpose/evidenceFrames or reviewEvidence. Current sourceSelection:{path,sha256} required. Optional per-mark sourceDimensions, sourceFile and visibility/hidden intervals.

speechCue.meaning: Unique current caption-layout row with matching scene/one-based paragraph and whitespace-normalized KO prefix. Intersect that exact cue start/end with native window and cut. No cue found or ambiguity stops; absent binding uses only inspected native window.
speechCue.paragraphAccepted: Integer2, digit string2 or full06-p02 ID.

annotationHelper.coordinates: Native decoded source pixels → aspect-contain current cut viewport, using each selected source actual dimensions. No crop accepted without new reviewed conversion.
retainedChecks: No extrapolation beyond strictly increasing inspected keyframes.
Rect/circle or path/arrow geometry and finite coordinates.
Actual label text preserved, no source-specific numeric rewrites or old ACVI cue special cases.
Output font metrics for source-anchor→top-left label positioning; existing safe label gutter clamp.
Each mark clipped to inspected native localStart/localEnd, current cut and optional speech cue. End times exclusive; clear at every source cut.
Existing video_pipeline.annotations(cut,plan) checks EVERY visible interpolated output-frame geometry, current font labels, credits, copyright notice, fixed caption and protected UI rectangles.
Native visibility/occlusion intervals map to cut-relative time, without inventing tracking after the final keyframe.
annotationHelper.outputs: On --prepare only, source-annotations.json and current edit-plan.json marks; mapping receipt includes source/title/caption/input hashes, cue bindings and all-frame geometry logs.
annotationHelper.dryRun: Computes mapping/protected-area geometry in memory, no media decode/render or writes.
annotationHelper.help: Stdlib only; PIL/audio/video dependencies imported after argument parsing.

reviewLimits: Source selection/specs/native-frame inspection supplied by root/source agents remain pending; code has not inspected actual images or source motion.
Geometry checks do not approve actual rendered moving/native/mobile pixels, final captions, source meanings or human listening.
No duplicate download/ASR/render, media change, browser/platform/Git operation, shared control mutation or foreign job action was performed.
platformBoundary: Current complete Drive user review before any YouTube upload; no automatic next video.
